question: In January 2022, Who among these has been awarded as Padma Bhushan Award in field of Science and Engineering?
solution:
The correct answer is Sanjay Rajaram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjay Rajaram**

 
 
• **​__Mexican scientist** Dr. Sanjaya Rajaram (1943–2021), who received the** 2014 World Food Prize**, **is of Indian descent**.
 
• He received this honour for his** scientific work in creating 480 wheat types that have been made available in 51 nations.**
 
• Building on the achievements of the Green Revolution, this innovation has increased global wheat production by more than **200 million tonnes**.
 
• He received the highest civilian honours from the Indian government, the Padma Shri (2001) and the Padma Bhushan (2022).
 
• Rajaram started working as a **wheat breeder **at the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center in Mexico in **1969.** (CIMMYT).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 

 
 

 Buddhadev Bhattacharya
 7th Chief minister of west bengal.
 
 

 Subbanna Ayyappan
 Subbanna Ayyappan received the Padma Shri award in 2022 from the Indian government, the third-highest honour in the Padma series of awards, in recognition of their outstanding contributions to the fields of **science and engineering**. The honour is given in appreciation of his contributions as a "Respected Aquaculture Scientist -** Powering India's Blue Revolution."**
 
 

 Sirpi Balasubramaniam
 A prominent Tamil author and poet, Dr. Sirpi Balasubramaniam (86), will receive the Padma Shri Award in January 2022. He has written almost **130 volumes, including the poetry collections Muganthu Theera Kadal and Senganthal, as well as several articles and around 20 novels in translation.**
